prompt: Can you guide me through training a custom ESRGAN model for upscaling game textures?
response: To train a custom ESRGAN model for upscaling game textures, start by preparing a dataset of low-resolution and high-resolution texture pairs. Use the ESRGAN GitHub repository as a starting point and modify the configuration file to suit your needs. Adjust parameters like the number of residual blocks and training epochs. Implement a custom loss function that emphasizes texture details. Use a powerful GPU to train the model and monitor its progress using TensorBoard. Once trained, evaluate the model's performance on a test set of textures.
